mat_help: Print at 100%. During setup, tap each printed dot in the camera preview?not on the paper.
camera_help: Position your device so the whole A3 mat and all four printed corner dots are visible. Tap the matching dots in the camera preview (not on the paper), in order: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.
corner: Tap the next corner in the camera preview
target: Find the {color} piece and place it in the matching box!
camera_denied: Camera access is needed to track the real activity. Enable camera permission and try again.
camera_error: Camera could not start. Check browser permission and close other apps using it.
no_cv: OpenCV could not load. Connect once to install the offline camera engine, then reload.
report_locked: Cloud coaching and therapist reports require an active DexPlay key.
key_invalid: That key could not be activated.
sms_optin: I agree to receive session and billing SMS reminders.
no_resources: No approved resources match this profile yet.
camera_privacy: Video stays on this device. DexPlay syncs session measurements only.
consent: I am a parent, caregiver, or clinician and have permission to set up this profile.
camera_processing_error: Camera image processing failed. Retry the camera or reload the page.
camera_waiting: The camera is still starting. You can begin now; the timer starts once the camera is ready. If an error appears, use Retry camera.
dwell_hint: Hold your finger over the zone for a moment
report_no_rounds: Round measurements will appear here after a completed game.
report_disclaimer: General activity feedback only—not a diagnosis, therapy, or individualized clinical advice.
report_translation_loading: Translating feedback into the selected app language…
report_translation_unavailable: Feedback is hidden until its translation is available. Connect to the internet, activate a cloud key, and make sure AI analysis consent is enabled.
report_ai_unavailable: AI feedback is not available for this session. Local measurements and session history are still available.
report_load_error: Saved report data could not be loaded.
difficulty_proposal_description: Review these suggested settings. They will only be used if you accept.
app_storage_error: Unable to open local storage. Please enable site storage and reload.
cloud_key_saved_notice: Cloud access is active. Your access key is saved on this device.
difficulty_saved_notice: Your selected game difficulty was saved for the next session.
difficulty_declined_notice: Difficulty proposal declined. The saved game settings were not changed.
delete_local_confirmation: Delete all DexPlay information stored on this device?
delete_cloud_confirmation: Delete all encrypted cloud sessions and revoke this account key?
delete_cloud_error: Cloud data could not be deleted.
delete_cloud_success: Cloud account and its encrypted session records were deleted.
resource_page_description: Reviewed links and locally saved catalog files. External links are not clinical validation.
resource_catalog_error: The resource catalog could not be loaded.
resource_empty_description: There are currently no published resources matching this broad age band.
resource_clinical_caveat: This link is not clinically validated.
resource_offline_open_failed: Offline file could not be opened. Download it again while online.
review_queue_description: Only designated reviewers can discover candidates or publish resources. Candidates are not shown to users before approval.
reviewer_access_description: Enter the server-configured reviewer credential for this page session. It is not saved in browser storage or sent to logs.
review_access_verified: Reviewer access verified. Pending items are visible only in this protected workflow.
review_queue_error: Could not load the review queue.
review_discovery_status: Discovery checked approved public feeds; {count} candidate(s) added. Daily requests: {used}/{limit}.
review_approved_status: Resource published after explicit human approval.
review_rejected_status: Candidate rejected and retained in the review history.
review_allowed_sources: Only approved public feeds are checked when discovery is started. Discovery is limited. Reviewers must verify access, licensing, age suitability, relevance, and safety before approval.
review_candidate_unapproved: Candidate only — not approved or visible to users.
review_manual_link_check: I manually checked that this link resolves to the reviewed resource
review_reviewer_notes: Reviewer notes (required if the link check is inconclusive)
review_clinic_approval: A clinic explicitly approved this resource for global use in this pilot
review_clinic_evidence_placeholder: Record the explicit clinic approval and its source.
review_publish_requirements: Publishing requires public-access review, age range, activity relevance, safety notes, and license status. Keep unknown license status explicit. If a link cannot be verified, its published record must show that status and the review notes.
ai_analysis_enabled: AI analysis enabled for this profile
sandbox_payment_notice: SANDBOX — test transactions only; no real charges.
payments_not_configured: Payments are not configured on this server.
payment_environment_error: Payment environment could not be checked.
notifications_unsupported: Notifications are not supported by this browser.
reminder_description: Daily reminders can appear while this app is open. Push reminders require an active cloud account. Sync stores encrypted session history; AI analysis runs only with separate profile consent.
sync_complete: Synced {count} session(s). Cloud reports are saved on this device.
sync_partial: Uploaded {count} session(s), but some reports could not be generated.
sync_no_round_data: No unsynced sessions found. {count} completed session(s) had no saved round data.
sync_ai_skipped: AI analysis was not requested for {count} session(s) because consent was off.
analysis_not_requested: AI analysis was not requested. Local measurements remain available.
analysis_unavailable: AI analysis is unavailable. Local measurements remain available.
